name: Lookback
description_en:
Lookback supports moderated and unmoderated remote research with recordings, stakeholder observation and AI-assisted analysis.

Its annual session allowance, separately priced participant recruitment and post-cancellation recording access are central to planning a study and its evidence archive.
description_zh:
Lookback 支持有主持及无主持远程研究，结合录像、相关人员观察和 AI 辅助分析。

规划研究及证据归档时，需要同时考虑年度会话额度、另计的参与者招募费和取消后的录像访问条件。

core_features.explanation_en: Live observation/private chat and asynchronous task sessions feed recordings and transcripts into the research workspace.
core_features.explanation_zh: 实时观察/私聊及异步任务会话将录像和转录汇入研究工作区。

core_features.name_zh: 带时间戳发现与跨会话查询
core_features.explanation_en: Discover searches session material; findings, clips and reels can communicate evidence, with exports gated to paid plans.
core_features.explanation_zh: Discover 查询会话材料，发现、片段和合集用于传达证据；导出限付费套餐。

core_features.explanation_en: A recorded interaction generally counts as one session; included panel participants cover recruitment fees, not incentives.
core_features.explanation_zh: 一次录制互动通常计一个会话；包含的面板参与者仅覆盖招募费，不包含激励。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Annual Freelance $299/10 sessions, Team $1,782/100, Insights Hub $4,122/300; checkout currency unconfirmed. Recruitment, incentives and 6% incentive management are separate. Trial 60 days/five sessions without export. Post-cancellation recordings retained 90 paid/30 trial days.

Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Run a focused research round and retain the source moments
sections.title_zh: 开展聚焦研究并保留原始时刻
sections.en:
The original lookback.io homepage redirects to the current lookback.com site, which presents the same Lookback research product. Its documented sequence starts with stakeholder goals, participant criteria and screeners, then moderated or independent sessions. Stakeholders can watch behind the scenes, use a private chat and take notes while recordings and transcripts are captured. Native mobile research is advertised through iOS and Android applications; exact device and permission compatibility was not tested.

For a hypothetical onboarding study, define the task and success criteria before recruiting. Let participants attempt the flow, then preserve a timestamped example for each finding. Lookback describes goal-relevant AI findings, transcript headlines and AI follow-up prompts, but the researcher should check suggestions against the full context. An AI follow-up may also change what later participants are asked; record that methodological difference when interpreting the study.
sections.zh:
原 lookback.io 首页会重定向至现行 lookback.com 网站，展示同一 Lookback 研究产品。文档流程从相关人员目标、参与者条件和筛选题开始，接着进行主持或独立会话。相关人员可在后台观察、私聊和记笔记，同时录制会话并生成转录。产品宣传通过 iOS 和 Android 应用开展原生移动研究；具体设备及权限兼容性未测。

以新手引导研究为假设，应在招募前定义任务和成功条件，让参与者尝试流程，再为每个发现保留带时间戳的例子。Lookback 描述按目标生成 AI 发现、转录标题和 AI 追问，但研究者应对照完整上下文检查建议。AI 追问还可能改变后续参与者收到的问题，解释研究时需记录这一方法差异。

sections.title_en: Budget a recording and a participant independently
sections.title_zh: 分别预算录像和参与者
sections.en:
The current price page lists annual Freelance at $299 for 10 sessions, Team at $1,782 for 100 and Insights Hub at $4,122 for 300. Extra sessions are sold in 10-session packages: respectively $299,$178 and $137 per package. Enterprise is custom and advertises unlimited sessions under its agreement. The dollar currency at checkout was not separately confirmed. There is no monthly plan according to the FAQ.

One recorded interaction with one participant generally uses one session, whether moderated or unmoderated; distinct recordings with the same person can count separately. Setup previews do not count, and the FAQ describes tolerance for very short/interrupted recordings and support credits if a count is wrong. Unused sessions expire with the trial or contract term. This makes an annual allocation different from permanent inventory. No real recording count or failed-session credit was tested.
sections.zh:
当前价格页列出 Freelance 年费 $299、10 个会话，Team $1,782、100 个，Insights Hub $4,122、300 个。额外会话以十个一包销售，分别为每包 $299、$178、$137。Enterprise 按合同定制并宣传无限会话。结账货币未另行确认。FAQ 说不提供月付套餐。

与一位参与者的一次录制互动通常消耗一个会话，无论有无主持；同一人的不同录制可能分别计数。设置预览不计数，FAQ 描述会对极短或中断录像作宽容处理，计数有误时可找客服补充会话。未用会话在试用或合同期末到期，因此年度额度并非永久库存。实际录像计数和失败会话补回未测试。

sections.title_en: Included participants do not include their compensation
sections.title_zh: 包含招募不等于包含参与者报酬
sections.en:
Freelance, Team and Insights Hub respectively list 1,10 and 30 included panel participants. The page expressly says these cover recruitment fees only. Incentives are separate, and incentive distribution through Lookback adds a 6% management fee. Bringing your own participants has no recruitment fee, but still consumes recorded sessions and does not remove the researcher’s compensation or consent responsibilities.

Pay-as-you-go recruitment is listed at $49 per participant. Discounted rates such as Team $38 and Insights Hub $31 require a minimum 10-person purchase; Enterprise lists $25 under its custom arrangement. The panel is powered by User Interviews and supports targeting/screeners. Niche availability, incentive size, actual fill time and suitability for a representative sample were not verified. Do not interpret advertised speed or panel size as a guarantee for a specialized audience.
sections.zh:
Freelance、Team 和 Insights Hub 分别列出 1、10、30 位包含的面板参与者。页面明确说只覆盖招募费，激励另算；通过 Lookback 发放激励时另加 6% 管理费。自带参与者没有招募费，但录制仍会消耗会话，也不免除研究者的报酬和同意责任。

随用随付招募列为每人 $49。Team 每人 $38、Insights Hub 每人 $31 等折扣要求至少购买十人；Enterprise 在定制安排下列为 $25。面板由 User Interviews 提供，支持定向和筛选题。细分人群可用量、激励金额、实际招满时间和样本代表性均未验证，宣传速度或面板规模不保证特定人群可用。

sections.title_en: Separate researchers, guests and evidence export
sections.title_zh: 区分研究者、访客和证据导出
sections.en:
Freelance lists one working seat, Team 10 collaborators and Insights Hub 30, with unlimited guests. The FAQ distinguishes collaborators who conduct and manage studies from temporary guests who view shared content and contribute notes/findings. A dedicated logged-in observer account is described as Enterprise only. Unlimited guests are therefore not unlimited research editors.

Discover can query material across sessions; findings and reels retain useful source moments, and paid plans can export recordings, transcripts and Discover logs. The 60-day trial includes five sessions without a credit card, but excludes exports and normally excludes Recruit launches; end-to-end recruitment may be requested from support. Test these limits before promising a client an export from a trial account. No export or MCP connection was executed.
sections.zh:
Freelance 列出一个工作席位，Team 为 10 个协作者，Insights Hub 为 30 个，并提供无限访客。FAQ 区分负责开展和管理研究的协作者，与查看分享内容、贡献笔记/发现的临时访客。独立登录的 observer 账户被描述为 Enterprise 才有。无限访客因此不等于无限研究编辑者。

Discover 可跨会话查询材料，发现和合集保留有用的来源时刻，付费套餐可导出录像、转录和 Discover 日志。60 天免信用卡试用包含五个会话，但排除导出，通常也不能启动 Recruit；完整招募测试可向客服申请。在承诺向客户导出前，应先检查试用限制。本研究未执行导出或 MCP 连接。

sections.title_en: Plan the archive before the subscription ends
sections.en:
The pricing FAQ says a canceled account cannot access recordings through the dashboard without a valid plan. Recordings are retained 90 days after a paid plan or 30 days after a trial, then permanently deleted; resubscribing before deletion restores access, and a paid archive arrangement can be discussed with support. “Unlimited recording storage” while subscribed is not indefinite post-cancellation access.

The reviewed Terms of Use are effective December 14,2020 and distinguish customer contracts from end-user terms. They describe a license to process session video/audio and metadata as reasonably necessary to provide, maintain and improve the platform, with authorized-user/provider distribution restrictions. Obtain participant permissions and check the actual customer agreement, current AI processing and redaction controls for sensitive research. Security/compliance claims were not independently audited and this draft does not establish specific model-training or data-residency assurances.
sections.zh:
价格 FAQ 说，没有有效套餐时，取消账户不能通过工作台访问录像。付费结束后保留 90 天，试用结束后保留 30 天，随后永久删除；删除前重新订阅可恢复访问，也可向客服咨询付费归档安排。订阅中的“无限录像存储”不代表取消后永久访问。

已读使用条款生效于 2020 年 12 月 14 日，将客户合同与终端用户条款区分。条款描述为提供、维护和改进平台而在合理必要范围内处理会话音视频及元数据的许可，并限制向授权用户/服务方分发。敏感研究需取得参与者许可，并核对实际客户协议、当前 AI 处理和遮盖控制。安全/合规宣传未独立审计，本稿未建立特定模型训练或数据地域保证。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: Confirm checkout currency, niche recruitment, participant compensation, actual customer agreement and current AI processing before a sensitive study.
research_gaps.zh: 敏感研究前需确认结账货币、细分人群招募、参与者报酬、实际客户合同和当前 AI 处理。

research_gaps.en: No participant session, device permission, export, redaction, MCP or deletion behavior was tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试参与者会话、设备权限、导出、遮盖、MCP 或删除行为。
